items.title: Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face
items.summary:
My comment on Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face — Hacker News.I think one of the most interesting details here might be tucked away in that first bulletin point:

May 7: OpenAI starts a new training run for an experimental, unreleased model. (Do they mean an evaluation run? They say training run in the video, and later mention a “reward signal to judge how well they’re doing”, so I guess this really was about training a model, not evaluating one that was already trained.)

items.title: The Right Way to Worry About AI
items.summary: Two headlines from one week — AI designing novel viruses and OpenAI's agents spontaneously building a message board to coordinate exploits — are the scariest AI news yet. NLW argues the terrifying part isn't the capability. It's whether we're actually having the conversation. And for once, he thinks we are.

items.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
